On May 30, 2020, Everett Jenks became 101 years old. Big celebration! On June 16, 2020, Everett and Charlie Jenks celebrated 75 years of being married. Bigger celebration! They were married in the Baptist church in Warton, Texas in 1945. Everett was in the U.S. Air Corps. Charlie was in West Texas, School of Nursing. At war’s end, they went to California. They raised three boys and “lived happily ever after.” (Courtesy)
